acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.
completion_conditions: After a full loop cycle including the closeout, `git merge origin/main` succeeds in the coordinator checkout with no manual step.
It still succeeds on a second cycle.
A newly added effector is covered without further change — staging happens at one point, not per-effector.
Nothing outside .shiki/ is staged and nothing is committed in the coordinator.
The full suite, the goal-loop suite and validate_shiki stay green.

decisions: MEASURED, WITH THE FIX PRESENT. The coordinator carried the merged staging fix (`git add -- *copied` in `_sync_state_to_branch`) from 15:27; the fix reached main at 15:09. At 15:46, after the closeout loop completed, `git merge origin/main` still aborted with 'The following untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge', naming six records written at 15:46 — AFTER the fix was in place.

THE SIX: `.shiki/goals/G-...4f95b5bf.json`, `.shiki/locks/T-...52142739.json`, `.shiki/tasks/T-...52142739.json`, two closeout ledgers, and `.shiki/reports/R-...18fd8360.json`. Every one is a closeout-era write.

CAUSE, read from source. `_sync_state_to_branch` has exactly three call sites — `:2063` create_pr, `:2103` dispatch_repair, `:2167` rerun_cca — so the staging added to it reaches only those. The `merge`, `mark_done`, `goal_complete` and `create_closeout_pr` effectors write the coordinator mirror through their own paths and stage nothing. `_create_closeout_pr` (`:1500`) builds the terminal state in a FRESH worktree cut from origin/main and commits there; the coordinator's own copies of the same records are written separately and left untracked.

SCOPE OF THE PREVIOUS TASK WAS RIGHT, ITS COVERAGE WAS NOT. Its acceptance criterion was 'after a loop cycle that writes mirror records, git merge origin/main succeeds' — the criterion is correct and remains the target. The implementation satisfied the letter of its scope prose (which named `_sync_state_to_branch`) and not the criterion. The CCA returned `complete` after verifying the change matched the scope; it did not drive the criterion end to end. That gap is recorded here, not repaired here.

DESIGN. Do not scatter a `git add` into each effector: `execute_action` has eleven branches (`:1983`-`:2227`) and any new one would silently reintroduce the defect. Stage once, at a single point that covers every effector — the loop's own `.shiki` working surface in the coordinator — so a future effector is covered by construction. STAGING ONLY, never committing: the coordinator's local branch must not advance.

MUST NOT: delete or move any mirror record to avoid the collision (the mirror is append-only evidence); stage anything outside `.shiki/`; change `_sync_state_to_branch`'s signature (`tests/test_loop_tdd_evidence.py:209-224` monkeypatches it) or what `_evidence_relatives_for_task` returns (`tests/test_mirror_lock_injection.py` asserts on it at `:320`, `:336`, `:498`); change what the closeout PR contains or the decision table `docs/adr/0012` pins.

LOCK-SUFFICIENCY CHECK (2026-08-06). MUST-CHANGE: `scripts/shiki_loop.py`; `tests/test_closeout.py` (47 references — owns the closeout effectors, where the six uncovered records are written); `tests/test_dispatch_state_sync.py` (owns the staging property the previous task introduced, and its assertion must widen from the sync paths to every effector).

MUST-NOT-BREAK (verification command, not locks): `tests/test_loop_branch_plumbing.py`, `tests/test_mirror_lock_injection.py`, `tests/test_loop_tdd_evidence.py`, `tests/test_loop_engine.py`, and `scripts/test_shiki_goal_loop.sh`, which drives the loop end to end including the closeout.

Risk is medium: this changes only which paths the loop stages in its own coordinator checkout. No gate, schema, workflow, approval source or delivered artifact moves. Under `.shiki/guardian-policy.json` (`applies_to_risk: [high, critical]`) neither PR triggers the Guardian gate.
grill_with_docs.source: Measured 2026-08-06 15:46 JST, immediately after PR #303 (the previous task's closeout) merged, in the coordinator checkout running the merged fix.

non_goals: Deleting or moving any mirror record to avoid the collision.
Committing in the coordinator — the local branch must not advance.
Changing what the closeout PR contains, or the decision table docs/adr/0012 pins.
Introducing any cross-task or cross-goal carry.
Repairing the CCA's end-to-end verification gap — recorded, not fixed here.
Touching any file outside the declared locks.
outcome: The acceptance criterion of T-20260806T034026771634Z-52142739 — that after a loop cycle `git merge origin/main` succeeds in the coordinator checkout without a manual back-up-and-delete — actually holds. It does not today: that task staged only what `_sync_state_to_branch` copies, and the closeout effectors write six more mirror records that still collide. Measured immediately after its own closeout merged.
title: Stage every coordinator mirror write, not only the three sync paths
